edits.old: Establishing a general insurance company in Bali? 65121 is the code, but the reality is tough: IDR 100 billion capital, 12–24 month OJK approval, intense competition. Most foreign investors find 66221 (insurance agent) a more practical entry point. Let me explain both paths.

Most foreign investors find 66221 (insurance agent) a more practical entry point. Let me explain both paths.
